headline: Hotjar: See how visitors use your website
body: Watch recordings of how users click and scroll, or see heatmaps of popular page areas. Find out what truly catches their eye! 👀
caption:
Hotjar's free plan helps you understand your website visitors better with limited recordings and heatmaps. It's a great way to start gathering insights without cost. Just remember to check their current free plan limits to see if it fits your needs. Start exploring your website's performance today!
